summary: Release animation with a pixel rocket: a three-second countdown, smoke on the pad, then liftoff while the stars streak past.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version shown in the "Launched · <version> is live" status. Read when the rocket leaves the frame.

events.name: liftoff
events.description: Fires when the countdown reaches zero and the rocket lifts off.

events.name: launched
events.description: Fires when the rocket has left the frame.

methods.description: Starts the countdown when the rocket is on the pad, or lands it again after a launch. Ignored mid-flight.

properties.name: version
properties.description: Version shown in the Live status; reflects the `version` attribute, or `v2.14` when it is missing.

accessibility: The canvas has `role="img"` and a fixed `aria-label="Rocket on the launch pad"`; the countdown numbers are drawn on the canvas in the monospace font and are not announced.
The status line is an `aria-live="polite"` region that announces Countdown, Liftoff, Launched and Landing.
The Launch / Land it control is a native button with `aria-disabled="true"` during the countdown, flight and landing; it keeps keyboard focus.
motion: With reduced motion, the rocket does not shake, no exhaust or smoke is drawn and the stars do not twinkle, scroll or streak; the rocket still rises and lands.
notes: The component does not publish anything; use `liftoff` and `launched` to hook in real work.
The host carries `data-state="gone"` while the rocket is away. The canvas is 236px tall and animates continuously while on screen, except at rest under reduced motion.

data.note: The countdown and the live state run on a timer, not on your release; only `version` can be set.
